page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware specifications include 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 384.0 GB, yielding a high resource allocation of 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

In terms of network capabilities, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The architecture contains no bundled local disk storage and zero GPU accelerators, meaning external block storage volumes must be attached for persistent data requirements. The compute resources operate with dedicated CPU allocation to eliminate host contention.

The high ratio of memory relative to vCPUs positions this instance for memory-intensive applications. Recommended deployment scenarios include enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale Redis caching layers, real-time data streaming analytics, and heavy ETL processing workloads where memory footprint dictates scaling limits.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Driven by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU based on x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 52 vCPUs paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high memory ratio of 7.38 GB per core. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it features a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance contains no integrated local storage and no dedicated GPU hardware acceleration, shifting storage dependencies entirely to attached network block devices. This hardware profile maximizes resource density for memory-bound applications. The ecs.r6.13xlarge is well-suited for high-density in-memory databases, large Redis caches, analytics processing platforms, and enterprise data processing environments requiring high RAM allocations without local drive overhead.
